about.heading: About me
about.p1: I graduated with a degree in digital economy in Katowice — somewhere between IT, business and project management. In my spare time I build tools that solve real problems — mine or someone I know. A fair description of my approach: "the fact that I need to learn something new along the way doesn't stop me — even if that something is Rust".
about.p2: Open to freelance projects and job offers — in Silesia or remotely.

services.heading: HOW I CAN HELP
services.intro: I build websites, web apps and AI automations for companies and teams that need more than an off-the-shelf template.

items.title: WEBSITES & APPS
items.body: A landing page, portfolio, or internal company tool — built from scratch, fast, and easy to maintain, without a bloated CMS.

items.title: AI AUTOMATION
items.body: Gemini/OpenAI integrations that turn repetitive manual work — cataloging, describing, data entry — into a process that takes seconds.

items.title: PROTOTYPE / MVP
items.body: Have an idea and want to validate it before investing in a full team? I build a working prototype you can put in front of real users.

process.title: CALL
process.body: You reach out, we talk through the problem and the goal.

process.title: QUOTE
process.body: You get a scope and a quote — no obligation.

process.title: BUILD
process.body: Regular updates while it's being built, not radio silence for a month.

process.title: HANDOFF
process.body: Code, access and docs — yours to keep, no lock-in.

services.pricing_note: Quote depends on project scope. Reach out — that's the first step.
